protocol.acceptance: one variant reaches sky correlation >= 0.99 in every case (handoff S4)
protocol.cases: open dust (Omega_Lambda = Omega_r = 0), Omega_0 in {0.3, 0.5, 0.7}, x in {0.62, 1.0}, z_E = 1100
protocol.doppler_diagnostic: pre-registered secondary map (not the acceptance): protocol redshift times the exact Doppler factors of the evolved dust velocity at the observer (N = 0) and at the emitter (N_E, ray direction from trace_rays)
protocol.euler_angles: every fit has beta within ~2e-5 of pi, where only alpha - gamma is determined; fits[].euler_determined gives that combination whenever |sin beta| < 1e-3
protocol.evolution: evolve_general_tilted_bianchi DOP853, N = 0 -> N_E(1 + 2/M) with N_E on the grid
protocol.fit: amplitude + SO(3) (active zyz, R = Rz(alpha) Ry(beta) Rz(gamma), map = amp S(R^-1 n)) of bjs_temperature_sky; global grid over the template axis (HEALPix nside 16 on the nside-32 map) with closed-form roll/amplitude, Nelder-Mead from up to 8 of the best grid local maxima (the grids had 2-4; fits[].n_starts_used) on the nside-64 map, final correlation with the exact template
protocol.line_of_sight: los_sky, one optically thick shell at N_E (nodes N_E - 1e-3, N_E, 0; delta_tau 1e6, 0), zero source increment, beta = None (normal observers), healpix_directions(64); dT/T = (1 + 4T)^(1/4) - 1, monopole removed
protocol.sigma_convention: sigma^2 = (1/2) sigma_ab sigma^ab = sigma_13^2 + sigma_23^2 = sigma_perp^2 (repository); amp_over_sigma_perp = fitted template (sigma/H)_0 / sigma_perp
protocol.spline_validation: run files: first 4096 ring pixels of the rotated frame (a polar cap), kept as fits[].spline_validation_first_4096_ring_pixels; full sky: cases[].spline_validation_full_sky (post-hoc)
protocol.state: N = 0, H = 1; a/H = sqrt(1 - Omega_0) e_z, n/H = diag(1/x, 1/x, 0) (bjs_lie_geometry_today); shear sigma_13 = sigma_23 = sigma_perp/sqrt(2) only; dust tilt from the exact momentum constraint; construct_admissible_tilted_state (tol 1e-11)

provenance.production_map_overwrite_note: before the review the --richardson runs wrote their main map under the production tag (no richardson flag in the tag), so the production map files were last written by the richardson runs (cases[].map_provenance: map_written_after_run_json, legacy_tag_shared_with_richardson_runs).  Their content equals the production runs' own record: content_check_vs_run_json (rms, max, Doppler rms) and fit_reproduction_max_corr_abs_diff (the recorded full-map correlation recomputed at every recorded axis).  The comparator now tags the main map of a richardson run with '_richrun'.
provenance.sources_changed_note: the runs were made with the source hashes in runs[].sources_sha256; the listed files differ in the working tree now (the maps are not regenerated here; the post-hoc checks use only the saved maps and the unchanged bjs_bianchi_vii_h.py)

repo_solve_compensating_tilt_velocity_no.note: the recorded values (0.7%-36%) describe the pre-fix repository function used by the runs; the working tree now evaluates the stable root, so a rerun with it records ~1e-16 (current_tree_rel_error below).  The S4 states never used the repository root: they use stable_compensating_tilt_velocity of the comparator.
